lines.l1: SKR Eyes, version one point two, is out. A new tab, a new board, and your place on the card. Here is the whole of it in ninety seconds.
lines.l2: First, what was already here. This is the vault as it stands right now. Every phone that falls in is a finalized stake, and every exit hangs above the pile and cools for forty eight hours.
lines.l3: Scroll, and the day is right there. What came in, what asked out, hour by hour.
lines.l4: Flow is every move as it lands, by kind and by size, with the day's biggest pinned on top.
lines.l5: Now the new part. Top: everybody who stakes, in order.
lines.l6: By stake, by what each position has earned, or by places moved since yesterday. The treasury wallets are set aside, so number one here is a person.
lines.l7: Your own place rides at the top, with your tier beside it, and the dial there is the door to the board.
lines.l8: Tap the dial and the whole vault becomes one board. Six rings, one for each tier. The people at the top stand as phones with their names, the beam sweeps, and you are the gold one.
lines.l9: Drag it, pinch it, tap anybody to read their name. One button brings you back to the list, and the dial takes you back to the board.
lines.l10: Me is where your own numbers live. Your weight in the vault, everything your stake has earned since your last move, read straight from the chain, and now your place among people as well.
lines.l11: Eleven languages. Sound only for the large moves. And the evening reminder no longer asks you to stake, it just says what moved.
lines.l12: SKR Eyes, version one point two. By Alex Kosa. Live on the Solana Mobile dApp Store.
